ti.title: ጸጋኻ ሃበኒ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ክርስቶስ ኣምላኸይ ናይ ሕይወተይ ቤዛ
ክርዳእ ፍቕርኻ ናይ ስቕለትካ ቃንዛ
ኣብ ጽላት ናይ ልበይ ፍቕርኻ ክሕተም
ዳህስሳ ንልበይ ብመንፈስ ክልብም (2)
[[/chorus]]

ጸጋኻ ሃበኒ ሕደጎ በደለይ
ከም ብዝሒ ምሕረትካ
ቀድሳ ንነፍሰይ

ካባኻ ርሒቐ ኮብሊለ ብበደል
ፍጹም ኣይፈተኻን ኣብ ሰልሚ ክትከል
ንኽብሪ ምስጋና ቆይሙ ዝተፈጥረ
ከም ፍቓድ ልብኻ ሕጂ’ውን ከበረ (2)

ti_ro.title: Tsegakha habeni
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Dahssa nlbey bmenfes klbm (2)
[[/chorus]]

Tsegakha habeni hdego bedeley
Kem bzhi mhretka
Qedsa nnefsey
Krstos amlakhey nay hywetey beza
Krda fqrkha nay sqletka qanza
Ab tslat nay lbey fqrkha khtem
Kabakha rhiqe koblile bbedel
Ftsum ayfetekhan ab selmi ktkel
Nkhbri msgana qoymu ztefetre
Kem fqad lbkha hji’wn kebere (2)
Kab key bedeley kab hsum barnet
Degim hara ye rekhibe natsnet
Kbri ms wdase kemu’wn msgana
Teqebel nsmka semayawi danya (2)
